Q1: How should this task be pointed at PR #7065's branch (`ai/issue-7059`) so planning and implementation check out the right code?
Choices:
A) A maintainer edits this issue's body to add this exact line on its own, at the start of a line: `Target branch: ai/issue-7059`. Then post `/reclarify`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close this issue and make the test-only change directly on PR #7065: the review editor or an interactive session updates the four negative `issues_created` assertions and the negative `comments_posted` read in `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py` on `ai/issue-7059`.
C) Go ahead against `main` with no target branch. **Note:** on `main` these assertions already handle a missing key, so this will most likely produce an empty change and will not fix PR #7065's failing check.
